concerns.text: Task T013a ('Implement Finite-Size Scaling Producer') is too coarse. It combines reading raw data, performing non-linear least squares fitting, error handling/logging, writing JSON output, AND generating a diagnostic plot. These are distinct implementation steps with different failure modes. Split into: (1) T013a-Fit: Implement the fitting logic and error handling; (2) T013a-Plot: Implement the plotting logic; (3) T013a-Write: Implement the JSON serialization.

Task T013d ('Aggregate PR Scaling Results') is too coarse. It requires reading two different JSON files, merging logic, schema validation, and writing a new file. Split into: (1) T013d-Read: Load and validate inputs; (2) T013d-Merge: Implement the merge logic; (3) T013d-Write: Serialize and save the aggregated result.

Task T013e ('Perform Global Regression & Slope Test') is too coarse. It combines filtering data, performing linear regression, calculating t-statistics, and writing output. Split into: (1) T013e-Reg: Implement regression and slope calculation; (2) T013e-Test: Implement t-statistic calculation; (3) T013e-Write: Serialize results.

Task T020b ('Implement analyze_tm.py') is too coarse. It includes the core TM algorithm, QR orthogonalization, finite-size scaling fit, convergence monitoring, and saving multiple artifacts (convergence trace, final results). Split into: (1) T020b-Core: Implement TM iteration and QR; (2) T020b-Fit: Implement the scaling fit; (3) T020b-Trace: Implement convergence logging; (4) T020b-Write: Save artifacts.

Task T029 ('Generate Quantitative Physical Summary') is too coarse. It involves identifying specific sites, performing interpolation, handling fallbacks, and writing a markdown table. Split into: (1) T029-Identify: Find half-amplitude site; (2) T029-Fit: Perform log-linear interpolation; (3) T029-Write: Generate the markdown table.

Task T036 ('Implement Physical Picture Narrative Generator') is too coarse. It reads multiple sections, applies a template, handles edge cases (W=0), and writes output. Split into: (1) T036-Read: Load quantitative metrics; (2) T036-Template: Apply the narrative template with fallbacks; (3) T036-Write: Append to markdown.

Task T038 ('Implement Evolution Sketch Generator') is too coarse. It iterates over multiple W values, computes metrics for each, and generates a summary table. Split into: (1) T038-Iterate: Loop over W values and compute metrics; (2) T038-Table: Format and write the summary table.
